sinopsis.es: Dos vampiros mestizos gemelos (Ranjith Sajeev y Aiswarya Raj) libran una guerra contra los asaltantes de una carretera del desierto, en un sanguinario curry western de artes marciales del guionista y director Samjad, con coreografía de Very Tri Yulisman (The Raid 2, The Night Comes for Us).
sinopsis.en: Twin half-blooded vampires (Ranjith Sajeev and Aiswarya Raj) wage war with desert highway hijackers in a gory martial arts curry western from writer-director Samjad and choreographer Very Tri Yulisman (The Raid 2, The Night Comes for Us).
